body.statement: Set \(\varepsilon=1/10\). In each model let \(U_X,U_A,U_B,U_C\) be independent fair bits and let \(E_Y,E_Z\) be independent \(\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\varepsilon)\) bits independent of them. The structural equations are \(M_1:X=U_X,\ Y=((1-X)U_A+XU_B)\oplus E_Y,\ Z=((1-X)U_B+XU_C)\oplus E_Z\), and \(M_2:X=U_X,\ Y=((1-X)U_A+XU_C)\oplus E_Y,\ Z=((1-X)U_B+XU_A)\oplus E_Z\). Both are positive binary SCMs compatible with \(X\to Y\), \(X\to Z\), and \(Y\leftrightarrow Z\). For every one of the \(27\) regimes \(r\in\{\mathrm{natural},0,1\}^{\{X,Y,Z\}}\), conditional on any natural or fixed value of \(X\), the unfixed \(Y\) and \(Z\) are independent fair bits in both models. Thus, for \(a=(a_X,a_Y,a_Z)\), both regime laws equal \(p_r(a)=\prod_{W:r_W\ne\mathrm{natural}}\mathbf1\{a_W=r_W\}\prod_{W:r_W=\mathrm{natural}}(1/2)\), which covers all simultaneous interventions on any subset of \(\{X,Y,Z\}\). Nevertheless \(P_{M_1}(Y_0=1,Z_1=1)=1/4\), while \(P_{M_2}(Y_0=1,Z_1=1)=\tfrac12((9/10)^2+(1/10)^2)=41/100\). In \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{sep}}=\{s,\chi_{Y,0},\chi_{Z,1},\rho_X,\rho_Y,\rho_Z\}\), SELECT \(s\) and all READs cost zero, each edge-specific CTF-RAND action costs one, and precedence is SELECT, then CTF-RAND, then READ, with no conflicts. The legal protocol \(S_{\mathrm{ind}}=\{s,\chi_{Y,0},\rho_X,\rho_Y,\rho_Z\}\) costs one, and its positive natural-\(X=1\) slice obeys \(P(Y=1,Z=1\mid X=1,S_{\mathrm{ind}})=P(Y_0=1,Z_1=1)\). The direct legal protocol \(S_{\mathrm{dir}}=\{s,\chi_{Y,0},\chi_{Z,1},\rho_Y,\rho_Z\}\) exposes the same joint without conditioning and costs two.
body.justification: The explicit response-bit coupling proves ordinary observational equivalence, the cross-world gap, and the one-versus-two physical acquisition cost in one auditable witness.
body.gap: Counterfactual realizability supplies the action semantics but not a positive binary pair with all 27 ordinary regime laws computed and a strict protocol-cost comparison.
body.consumer: The witness is a complete regression fixture for the optimizer and certifies that the richer protocol class has genuine economic value.
